~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ building distribution switch ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!

  name {net_type_6_Vlan_name}
!

 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_user}
